description: Packages with sourceRoot = "." unpack into the build top dir; stdenv then runs chmod -R u+w . which fails on Determinate Nix's external-builders Linux VM because it leaves a root-owned builder.json there. Blocks openspec (via pnpm) and aperture-cli, hence llm-toolchain, on aarch64-linux when built through that VM. Unpack flat archives into a fresh subdirectory instead (shared helper used by buildPrebuiltBinary, pnpm, platform-tools).
title: Flat-tarball unpack fails on Determinate Nix external-builders Linux VM
